Builddrone 0.5.2 is a security release. It closes remaining intermediate-path
symlink bypasses in upload, copy, and archive modules that still treated only
the leaf path as a symlink.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Buildrone/latest/

---

## Security fixes

### Full-path symlink-component rejection

Workspace paths used by `twine.upload`, `appveyor.upload.tests`,
`appveyor.upload.artifact`, `filesystem.copy`, and `archiver` now reject any
path whose components under the workspace base include a symlink, not only a
leaf `Path.is_symlink()`.

This prevents a contributor from planting a directory symlink at an expected
prefix such as `dist`, `results`, `artifacts`, or `outer` so that glob matches,
nested sources, and listed files resolve to regular files on the host and are
uploaded, copied, or packed.

`filesystem.copy` also rejects a destination whose path components include a
symlink, so `makedirs` and `copy2` cannot write through an attacker-chosen
directory link. Nested folder walks still use `followlinks=False`, and
symlinked source files continue to be skipped with a warning.

`archiver` rejects an archive `filename` that is a file symlink or whose parent
path includes a symlink before `ZipFile` opens the destination, so a planted
filename link cannot clobber a host file.
